check_status.title: Check API status
check_status.description: Confirm the API is up and the key is valid; returns ok with the key's masked token.

list_knowledge.title: List knowledge items
list_knowledge.description: List the account's knowledge sources -- websites, videos, documents and FAQs -- with their training state.

get_knowledge.title: Get a knowledge item
get_knowledge.description: Read a knowledge item's type, source and training state: trained_at, is_training and any training failure. Poll it after train_knowledge.

list_knowledge_sub_pages.title: List a website's pages
list_knowledge_sub_pages.description: List the pages crawled for a website knowledge item and whether each trained.

list_faq_items.title: List FAQ items
list_faq_items.description: List the questions and answers in an FAQ knowledge item.

create_website_knowledge.title: Add a website
create_website_knowledge.description: Create a knowledge item from a website, which Aidbase crawls. Train it before use.

website_url.description: Website to crawl, starting with http:// or https://.

create_video_knowledge.title: Add a YouTube video
create_video_knowledge.description: Create a knowledge item from a YouTube video's content. Train it before use.

video_url.description: YouTube video URL; only YouTube is accepted.

create_document_knowledge.title: Start a document upload
create_document_knowledge.description: Create a document knowledge item (PDF, Word, plain text or CSV) and get a signed upload_url. PUT the file there, then call finalize_document_knowledge.

output.description: The item id and signed upload_url.

finalize_document_knowledge.title: Finalize a document upload
finalize_document_knowledge.description: Complete a document knowledge item once its file has been uploaded to the signed URL.

create_faq_knowledge.title: Create an FAQ
create_faq_knowledge.description: Create an empty FAQ knowledge item; add questions with add_faq_item.

add_faq_item.title: Add an FAQ item
add_faq_item.description: Add a question and answer to an FAQ knowledge item, with optional categories and source URL.

categories.description: Category names; missing ones are created.

delete_knowledge.title: Delete a knowledge item
delete_knowledge.description: Delete a knowledge item; every chatbot, ticket form and inbox using it loses that knowledge.

delete_faq_item.title: Delete an FAQ item
delete_faq_item.description: Delete one question and answer from an FAQ knowledge item.

train_knowledge.title: Train a knowledge item
train_knowledge.description: Start training a knowledge item so it can answer questions. It takes a while; poll get_knowledge until is_training is false.

list_chatbots.title: List chatbots
list_chatbots.description: List the account's chatbots with the ids the other chatbot tools need.

get_chatbot.title: Get a chatbot
get_chatbot.description: Read one chatbot's configuration: name, behaviour and settings.

chatbot_reply.title: Get a chatbot reply
chatbot_reply.description: Ask a chatbot a question and get its AI answer, drawn from its trained knowledge. Pass the returned session_id to continue the conversation.

session_id.description: session_id from a previous reply, to continue that conversation.

output.description: The reply, its id and the session_id.

list_chatbot_knowledge.title: List a chatbot's knowledge
list_chatbot_knowledge.description: List the knowledge items a chatbot answers from.

add_chatbot_knowledge.title: Attach knowledge to a chatbot
add_chatbot_knowledge.description: Let a chatbot answer from a trained knowledge item.

knowledge_id.description: Knowledge item id; it must already be trained.

remove_chatbot_knowledge.title: Detach knowledge from a chatbot
remove_chatbot_knowledge.description: Stop a chatbot using a knowledge item; the item itself is kept.

list_chatbot_chats.title: List chatbot chats
list_chatbot_chats.description: List a chatbot's conversations, optionally within a creation window.

created_after.description: Only chats created after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

created_before.description: Only chats created before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

get_chatbot_chat.title: Get a chatbot chat
get_chatbot_chat.description: Read one chatbot conversation with its messages.

block_chatbot_chat.title: Block a chat
block_chatbot_chat.description: Block the user behind a chatbot conversation from interacting further. Needs CHATBOTS_WRITE.

list_ticket_forms.title: List ticket forms
list_ticket_forms.description: List the account's ticket forms with the ids the ticket tools need.

get_ticket_form.title: Get a ticket form
get_ticket_form.description: Read one ticket form's configuration: name, fields and settings.

list_ticket_form_knowledge.title: List a ticket form's knowledge
list_ticket_form_knowledge.description: List the knowledge items a ticket form's AI draws on.

add_ticket_form_knowledge.title: Attach knowledge to a ticket form
add_ticket_form_knowledge.description: Let a ticket form's AI use a trained knowledge item.

knowledge_id.description: Knowledge item id; it must already be trained.

remove_ticket_form_knowledge.title: Detach knowledge from a ticket form
remove_ticket_form_knowledge.description: Stop a ticket form using a knowledge item; the item itself is kept.

list_tickets.title: List tickets
list_tickets.description: List a ticket form's tickets, optionally by status and creation window.

status.description: Statuses, comma-separated: open, assigned, need_more_info, resolved, closed.

created_after.description: Only tickets created after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

created_before.description: Only tickets created before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

get_ticket.title: Get a ticket
get_ticket.description: Read one ticket with its messages, status and priority.

update_ticket.title: Update a ticket
update_ticket.description: Change a ticket's status, priority or both -- at least one -- with the same history and side effects as in the app. Needs TICKETS_WRITE.

priority.description: New priority, e.g. low, medium or high.

block_ticket.title: Block a ticket
block_ticket.description: Block the customer behind a ticket from interacting further. Needs TICKETFORMS_WRITE.

reply_to_ticket.title: Reply to a ticket
reply_to_ticket.description: Send a reply to a ticket's customer as the form owner or a chosen persona. Needs TICKETS_WRITE.

message.description: Reply text sent to the customer.

persona_id.description: Persona to send as; defaults to the account's name and picture.

list_email_inboxes.title: List email inboxes
list_email_inboxes.description: List the account's email inboxes with the ids the email tools need.

get_email_inbox.title: Get an email inbox
get_email_inbox.description: Read one email inbox's configuration, by id or alias.

list_email_inbox_knowledge.title: List an inbox's knowledge
list_email_inbox_knowledge.description: List the knowledge items an email inbox's AI draws on.

add_email_inbox_knowledge.title: Attach knowledge to an inbox
add_email_inbox_knowledge.description: Let an email inbox's AI use a trained knowledge item.

knowledge_id.description: Knowledge item id; it must already be trained.

remove_email_inbox_knowledge.title: Detach knowledge from an inbox
remove_email_inbox_knowledge.description: Stop an email inbox using a knowledge item; the item itself is kept.

list_emails.title: List emails
list_emails.description: List an inbox's email conversations, optionally by status and creation window.

status.description: Statuses, comma-separated: open, assigned, need_more_info, resolved, closed.

created_after.description: Only emails created after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

created_before.description: Only emails created before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

get_email.title: Get an email
get_email.description: Read one email conversation with its messages, status and priority.

update_email.title: Update an email
update_email.description: Change an email conversation's status, priority or both -- at least one. Needs EMAILS_WRITE.

priority.description: New priority, e.g. low, medium or high.

block_email.title: Block an email sender
block_email.description: Block the sender of an email conversation from interacting further. Needs EMAILINBOXES_WRITE.

reply_to_email.title: Reply to an email
reply_to_email.description: Send a reply to an email conversation as the inbox owner. Needs EMAILS_WRITE.

message.description: Reply text sent to the customer.
